query: What is the total retail purchase price (MSRP) of a new entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 in USD? Do not use monthly financing. How much would it cost in Canadian Dollar (CAD) if the exchange rate is 1.36 CAD for 1 USD?

facts.text: What is the total retail purchase price (MSRP) of a new entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 in USD? Do not use monthly financing. How much would it cost in Canadian Dollar (CAD) if the exchange rate is 1.36 CAD for 1 USD?

Action: duckduck
Action Input: entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 MSRP
Observation: The 11-inch iPad Pro with the M4 chip starts at $999. The 13-inch model starts at $1,299. Both are available for order today and will be in stores next week.
 The entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 refers to the smallest screen size and base storage. According to the search result, the 11-inch iPad Pro with the M4 chip starts at $999. This is the entry-level model.

Now I need to convert this USD price to CAD using the given exchange rate of 1.36 CAD for 1 USD.
Action: Calculator
Action Input: 999 * 1.36
Observation: 1358.64
 I have the MSRP in USD and the converted price in CAD.
The total retail purchase price (MSRP) of a new entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 is $999 USD. It would cost $1358.64 CAD.
